scope: Official MTR 4.1.0-beta.2 OBJ design audit; no game launch, no v6, no production edits

native_obj_contract.raw_read_location: VehicleModel.getModelLoaderBase synchronously calls provider.get before ObjModelLoader.loadModel
native_obj_contract.submission: ObjModelLoader.loadModel increments parseStarted, then captures raw String/functions/flags in submitted Runnable
native_obj_contract.parse: String -> IOUtils.toInputStream UTF_8 -> ObjReader InputStreamReader US_ASCII -> native ObjSplitting/ObjUtils.convertToRenderable -> native StoredVertexData
native_obj_contract.mtl_parse: Referenced MTL String -> UTF_8 InputStream -> MtlReader default-charset InputStreamReader; MTL failure logs and continues fallback
native_obj_contract.completion: Runnable sets modelLoaded only after all groups/materials are loaded; parseFinished executes on success, caught Exception and finally exceptional exit
native_obj_contract.submission_failure: No catch/finally around ExecutorService.submit after parseStarted; a rejected submit can leak native ticket; module inline redirect should bypass the native executor for its owned calls
native_obj_contract.material_context: MTL and texture resolution are anchored in the ORIGINAL factory modelString through getResourceFromSamePath; material options and flip flag affect output
native_obj_contract.ownership: Share source mesh staging only; separate ModelLoaderBase TRIANGLES facades keep builtModel1/builtModel2 private
native_obj_contract.raw_read_error_fallback: ResourceManagerHelper catches a decode/read Exception and returns its initialized empty String. Managed OBJ descriptor admission alone does not distinguish a real empty OBJ from a swallowed read/guard failure.

minimal_design: Repair default text guard using a documented heap-derived sizing policy and replay exact largest fixture; do not special-case paths or increase threshold by measured delta

Treat OBJ admission/shared sources as a distinct engineering expansion of the declared BB/foreign-native boundary, justified by real workload evidence rather than claiming an existing total-process bound
Reuse GenerationWorkCache with descriptor-only suppliers and ReadAdmission.GLOBAL; capture generation before admission; read raw and MTL only inside owned admitted worker scope
Add ObjModelLoader executor redirect to same generic native-owned scope mechanism, so original native Runnable runs inline; preserve all native reader/material/bake code

Use a provider-identity/modelId/original-model-anchor/texture/flip key and path-scoped content key until a complete material dependency/resolver equivalence key exists; raw OBJ digest alone is insufficient
Create independent TRIANGLES facades from native source mesh maps; do not share per-consumer built holders or mutate shared groups
Use generic native capture loaded-after-Runnable check to make native parse-without-publication a terminal failed future; keep native MTL fallback semantics

For managed native resource reads, preserve original decode/read/missing failures with an ownership-scoped error handoff checked before BoundedTextCache publication; do not reject every empty OBJ String. MTL-specific native fallback stays intact.
Retire/finish/report OBJ work with same lifecycle gates and observe OBJ plus BB stats so quiescence cannot accidentally omit OBJ tasks
required_tests: Native-reference bitwise mesh/group/stage/texture/bounds/triangle/winding/normal/UV equivalence for quads, groups, material options, MTL Kd/d/mapKd and flipV
UTF8 to US_ASCII reference equivalence for non-ASCII OBJ names/comments and default-charset MTL names; do not replace the InputStream reader with StringReader
Provider+same-path path-hit read count; same raw in different original anchors/providers must not alias material/texture results
Repeated same OBJ source gives distinct facades and independent builtModel holder ownership; native source staging is unchanged by facade reset/build
Malformed OBJ/native bake exception yields unloaded terminal facade, zero pending future, same-path correction retry, balanced module/native tickets and permits; allow legitimate native empty models
Native MTL missing/malformed input retains native fallback and warning; explicit resource-limit errors remain observable
Actual ResourceManagerHelper missing/oversize/decode/read-error paths must not turn a managed raw OBJ source into a successful empty model; compare a truly empty input separately.
Queued/running cancellation, timeout ignoring interruption, replacement generation and admission wait retirement; hold tickets/permits until actual native exit
Actual official packaged OBJ factory/executor Mixin application plus paused parser/reload/retry fault probe; headless tests alone cannot prove hooks
Exact full-16-pack run verifies largest input no longer guard-rejected, real rendered geometry and settled BB/OBJ/native counts, then full reload/long-session/performance gates
